lessons.text: New objects inherit the last-used fill and stroke; set paint explicitly after every create. Not universal: DesignCraft frames start with no fill and do not inherit, and FigCraft's new rectangle came out the default #D9D9D9 (both tested), so probe each app and set the inherits_last_style flag.

Operations act on the current selection; select first or they fail with 'nothing selected' (imageTrace.make). Some apps (CADCraft) do not auto-select new objects: pass the returned ids or handles explicitly.

lessons.text: Check whether a command mutates before running it: find.py --readonly. AniCraft and WordCraft registries carry a native mutates flag; elsewhere the guess accepts only an exact action word as the last id segment (get, list, info, inspect, describe, find, query, read, count, status, check, preview, help, sample, capabilities). The native flags exposed unsafe prefix matches (find.replace, developer.checkBox, styles.inspectorClear). Against them the guess has 0 misses on AniCraft (240 commands) and 2 on WordCraft (670: mailings.preview and file.inspect, UI-state toggles a name cannot reveal), with many conservative false alarms (exports, selection).

lessons.text: Each CLI call is its own session: only saved files persist. Selection and other session state do not carry over, so an edit that needs a selection must run in one batch or script with the select step; save with the app's output flag (-o) or an explicit save.
